description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Wathurugama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampha District (25/55040)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property and registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land schedules with parcel numbers, extents, and registration details, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
